subject: Audit/export windows for access logs — retention, deletion, and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Olivia Hughes <olivia.hughes@finservcorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@finservcorp.com, security@finservcorp.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Request: access/audit log retention + export capability for upcoming audit

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

We're kicking off prep for our internal compliance audit the week of 2026-11-02. A couple of concrete asks so we can scope evidence collection:

- What are Redwood's default retention windows for access logs and audit trails (hosted API requests, console admin events, token-level access)?
- Can we export logs in bulk (CSV/JSONL) for periods > 1 year? Any per-export time window limits or throttles?
- Do you provide streaming delivery (syslog/S3) for continuous ingestion into our SIEM?
- If we request deletion of historical audit data for an account, what is the deletion workflow and how long before data is removed from backups?
- Can you produce a signed attestation / timestamped snapshot we can include in the audit evidence bundle?

We have an initial scope of 2019-2026 for certain high-privilege events; please let us know constraints and the fastest path to get an export + evidence.

Thanks,
Olivia Hughes
Sr. Security Manager, FinServ Corp
olivia.hughes@finservcorp.com

[Note: attaching a CSV sample spec would be useful when you reply]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hughes <olivia.hughes@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access/audit log retention + export capability for upcoming audit

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise summary and next steps; attaching our export spec and a retention exhibit for quick reference (see attachments).

Summary (short):
- Hosted (default): access/audit logs retained 90 days for standard hosted plans.
- Dedicated / Enterprise add-on: configurable retention up to 7 years (we persist index/metadata and compressed archives).
- Private deployments: retention fully customer controlled (VPC/on-prem).

Export capabilities:
- Formats: CSV, JSONL (line-delimited), gzipped JSONL bundles, and streaming via Syslog (TCP/TLS) or continuous push to customer S3-compatible buckets.
- Export windows: hosted API supports ad-hoc exports up to 180 days per job via the self-serve export tool. For timelines > 180 days we provide an "archive export" process that packages older data into a single signed bundle (integrity SHA256 hashes) — this is handled by our ops team and typically completes within 3–7 business days depending on size.
- Large-volume delivery: for multi-year archives we can stage exports to a pre-signed S3 URL you control or transfer via secure file share.

Deletion and backups:
- Deletion request flow: 1) Customer requests deletion -> 2) soft-delete marker placed (visible in console) -> 3) scheduled purge (default 30 days after soft-delete) -> 4) permanent delete from primary stores and indexes.
- Backups/replicas: backup retention varies by offering — hosted snapshots are kept for up to 90 days; Dedicated customers can opt-in to longer backup retention. For hosted accounts we estimate final removal from backups within 30–90 days of purge depending on snapshot schedule and replication. We can include a deletion confirmation note and approximate backup purge timestamp in the export.

Attestation & evidence:
- We can produce a signed timestamped export manifest (SHA256 digests + signing key) and a short attestation letter on Redwood letterhead. If you need a formal SOC-like artifact, we can route to our compliance team for a tailored statement (add-on).

Next steps / asks from you:
1) Can you confirm the exact time range and preferred delivery method (S3 vs syslog vs downloadable bundle)?
2) For any >180 day export windows, please confirm whether you prefer us to prepare an operations-run archive (we'll need approval from your security contact for transfer).
3) If you want a deletion attestation after purge, let us know so we can include language in the addendum.

I've looped in Karthik for backup/deletion SLAs and Marissa for account-level coordination. Attaching: redwood-audit-export-specs.pdf and retention-exhibit-2026.xlsx.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Olivia Hughes <olivia.hughes@finservcorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, audits@finservcorp.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access/audit log retention + export capability for upcoming audit

Thanks Vanessa — that is helpful. A couple of clarifications:

- Our audit scope wants an immutable copy covering 2019-2026 for high-privilege admin events. Can you confirm you can produce a bundled archive (gzipped JSONL) with per-file SHA256 hashes for that entire period? Est. size is ~120 GB based on sample rates.
- For deletion: our compliance team requires confirmation that deleted records will be removed from your backups within 90 days. Will Redwood commit to documenting the backup purge timestamp as part of the deletion attest?
- We may request an attestation letter for the 2026 audit; please advise on lead time and whether this requires an additional compliance agreement.

If you can confirm those three items, we'll file a formal evidence request and share an S3 bucket endpoint for transfer.

—Olivia

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hughes <olivia.hughes@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: access/audit log retention + export capability for upcoming audit

Olivia — quick answers and proposal:

1) Multi-year archive: yes. We can assemble a gzipped JSONL archive for 2019–2026 with per-file SHA256 digests; for a dataset ~120 GB we estimate 4–6 business days operational lead time once you open a formal export ticket. We'll provide a signed manifest (timestamp + digests) and a secure pre-signed S3 transfer or direct SFTP endpoint — whichever you prefer.

2) Backup purge confirmation: Karthik confirmed (cc'd) that for hosted Enterprise add-on exports we will include an explicit backup-purge estimate and a deletion confirmation record. For hosted standard plans our standard backup window is 90 days; for your account (FinServ Corp) we can document the planned purge timestamp and include that note in the attestation.

3) Attestation letter: can be produced within 3 business days after the export is finalized; formal SOC artifacts require our compliance team and often an addendum. If you want the attestation on Redwood letterhead (signed), we'll route a one-off compliance statement and provide the text for your records.

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa to open a formal export ticket and confirm target delivery (S3 bucket endpoint + contact).
- Olivia to confirm acceptance of the 4–6 business day lead time for the archive run.
- I'll prepare the attestation template and retention note; Karthik will provide the backup purge language we will include.

Marissa — can you initiate the ticket and share the secure bucket details?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Onboarding notes: redwood-audit-export-specs.pdf (attachment) — includes field map, timestamp formats, and sample manifest format. retention-exhibit-2026.xlsx — shows retention options by offering and backup windows.
